$comment: pnpm lhci (scripts/lhci.ts) runs Lighthouse CI on the production build: mobile, three runs a page, failing below NFR-PERF-02's budget. The phone is SRS §10's lab phone as Lighthouse simulates it: a 4× CPU slowdown on Chrome's "Fast 4G", 60 ms and 9 Mbps (9,216 Kbps, as Lighthouse counts 1,024 to a Mbps), not Lighthouse's own phone network of 150 ms and 1.6 Mbps (D-049). It gives Chrome the flags every Chromium here gets (scripts/checks/chromium.ts).

pages: NFR-PERF-02's pages. The task that builds a page adds its paths, in both locales, once it paints. Until then the page is pending, because Lighthouse can't score a page that paints nothing (D-037). The car page is seed car s01's, whose slug moves with the seed. s01 has no photos, so its largest paint is the title's text and no cover is measured; once a seed car has photos, its paths take s01's place. D-049 records the car page measured with photos.
